title: Align AskUserQuestion tool with the TS baseline
objective: Implement all AskUserQuestion improvements identified by the per-tool subagent report so the Go clone matches the original TypeScript tool in public contract, runtime logic, robustness, state lifecycle, and tests.

context.problem: Exact surface; the CLI questionnaire flow is close, but Go still returns serialized JSON text instead of the richer original typed result pipeline.
context.source_note: Synthesized because the initial early subagent report was returned in chat but not persisted by the read-only role; inputs were the current tools/reports markdown, the handoff summary, and the historical task JSON under ../tasks.

parallelization_notes: Can be assigned to an implementation subagent after listed dependencies are available. Avoid running concurrently with another task that owns the same files.

improvement_points.title: Strict question / option schema with validation
improvement_points.description: TS schema requires 1-4 questions; each question has 2-4 options; question text must end with '?'; option labels are 1-5 words concise; header chip max 12 chars; multiSelect bool; questions cannot have an 'Other' option (UI auto-adds it).

improvement_points.title: Preview rendering rules (single-select only)
improvement_points.description: TS allows preview content as monospace markdown box. When ANY option in a question has preview, UI switches to side-by-side; multi-select questions cannot use previews.

improvement_points.title: Auto-injected 'Other' option semantics
improvement_points.description: TS auto-adds 'Other' so the user can supply free-text. Tool must accept that response and surface it under 'Other' answer key.

improvement_points.title: Transport: post questions and await answers
improvement_points.description: TS posts questions through SendMessage envelope and awaits user reply with request_id correlation.

improvement_points.title: Plan-mode auxiliary support
improvement_points.description: TS notes that AskUserQuestion in plan mode must not be used to ask 'Should I proceed?' (use ExitPlanMode). Surface guard rail.

improvement_points.title: Annotations payload (preview notes)
improvement_points.description: TS supports per-question annotations (notes, selected preview content) returned alongside answers.

improvement_points.title: Mirror AskUserQuestion typed result and updatedInput lifecycle
improvement_points.description: Return TS-shaped typed answers/annotations data instead of JSON text only, and preserve the permission/updatedInput lifecycle when user answers are collected.

implementation_subtasks.title: Strict question / option schema with validation
implementation_steps: Define Question struct {Text, Header string; MultiSelect bool; Options []Option}.
Define Option struct {Label, Description string; Preview *string}.
Validate counts (1-4 questions, 2-4 options); reject 'Other' label; require '?' suffix; cap header at 12 chars.
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS schema requires 1-4 questions; each question has 2-4 options; question text must end with '?'; option labels are 1-5 words concise; header chip max 12 chars; multiSelect bool; questions cannot have an 'Other' option (UI auto-adds it).

implementation_subtasks.title: Preview rendering rules (single-select only)
implementation_steps: Validate preview length under reasonable cap (e.g. 4000 chars).
Tag question with HasPreview bool for UI hint.
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS allows preview content as monospace markdown box. When ANY option in a question has preview, UI switches to side-by-side; multi-select questions cannot use previews.

implementation_subtasks.title: Auto-injected 'Other' option semantics
implementation_steps: When parsing user reply, recognise sentinel 'Other:<text>' or annotation block.
acceptance_criteria: Selection not lost when both used
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS auto-adds 'Other' so the user can supply free-text. Tool must accept that response and surface it under 'Other' answer key.

implementation_subtasks.title: Transport: post questions and await answers
implementation_steps: Parse reply into AskUserQuestionResult {Answers, Annotations, Metadata}.
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS posts questions through SendMessage envelope and awaits user reply with request_id correlation.

implementation_subtasks.title: Plan-mode auxiliary support
implementation_steps: Detect approval-style questions heuristically (regex on text and options).
Emit warning instructing tool to use ExitPlanMode instead.
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS notes that AskUserQuestion in plan mode must not be used to ask 'Should I proceed?' (use ExitPlanMode). Surface guard rail.

implementation_subtasks.title: Annotations payload (preview notes)
implementation_steps: Define AnnotationEntry struct {Notes string; Preview string}.
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS supports per-question annotations (notes, selected preview content) returned alongside answers.

implementation_subtasks.title: Conformance tests
implementation_steps: Add gosrc/tools/ask_user_question_conformance_test.go covering schema, preview rules, multi-select, Other parsing.

implementation_subtasks.title: Mirror AskUserQuestion typed result and updatedInput lifecycle
implementation_steps: Return TS-shaped typed answers/annotations data instead of JSON text only, and preserve the permission/updatedInput lifecycle when user answers are collected.
acceptance_criteria: Result data is typed and model-visible text remains TS-compatible.
updatedInput/answer lifecycle can be consumed by the runtime rather than reparsing JSON text.

risks: Some subtasks touch shared runtime surfaces; coordinate with foundation tasks to avoid incompatible local adapters.
non_goals: Do not make unrelated behavior changes outside this tool unless required by a listed dependency.
notes_for_assignee: Start by adding or updating parity fixtures, then implement the smallest vertical slice that makes a failing fixture pass. Keep TS evidence lines in comments or test names where useful.
